provider: NSE (National Stock Exchange of India) archive
instruments: all securities in the CM bhavcopy for the date
missing_note: no file published for this date (holiday, non-trading day or not yet published); no bars were created
known_limitations: Prices are raw (unadjusted) for splits, bonuses and dividends.
All CM series are kept (EQ, BE, SM, GS, ...); universe/series selection happens downstream.
No delivery quantity (that is in a separate NSE file).
Universe is the set of securities traded that day, not point-in-time index membership.
terms: NSE data, published for educational and informational use only; not for commercial use or redistribution. Raw and processed files stay git-ignored. See NSE Terms of Use.
